body:
@Lil-Sassy, In this [snippet](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8ae5300319f14f8253c8158b846f355b/editor/scene/canvas_item_editor_plugin.cpp#L4690), the insert_node_value_key function only inserts position and rotation keyframes.
Scale is intentionally not added because the flag [key_scale](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8ae5300319f14f8253c8158b846f355b/editor/scene/canvas_item_editor_plugin.h#L260) is explicitly set to false
 
 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8ae5300319f14f8253c8158b846f355b/editor/scene/canvas_item_editor_plugin.h#L260

Therefore, this is a intended behavior, not a bug.

There are many properties other than position/rotation/scale, do you need any specific properties to be inserted when insert key is pressed. Clarify me about your requirement.
